basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Austin, Texas. I recently joined Reddit to explore various communities and learn more about topics I'm passionate about. I love discussing technology trends and keeping up with current events, especially around global conflicts like the Ukraine-Russia situation. When I'm not working, I enjoy off-roading adventures in my Ford Maverick and trying new recipes. I'm single and usually browse Reddit during evenings after work, around 7-9 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for 5 years. My expertise lies in software development and I'm always keen on expanding my knowledge through self-learning and engaging in tech forums.
